evals.name: clear-conversion-request
evals.prompt: Convert this complete writing skill into an optimized Notion skill. It includes SKILL.md, six workflow files, references, examples, and evals.
evals.expected_output: The skill audits every supplied file and returns only a source audit, proposed hierarchy, and routing map. It does not create Notion pages before approval.

evals.name: ambiguous-architecture-request
evals.prompt: Clean up this skill in Notion. It is hard to navigate.
evals.expected_output: The skill distinguishes an architecture review from immediate migration, inspects the available source, identifies missing context that would materially affect the proposal, and preserves the approval gate.

evals.name: non-skill-request
evals.prompt: Turn these meeting notes into a project update in Notion.
evals.expected_output: The skill should not treat ordinary note formatting as an agent-skill architecture migration and should route the request elsewhere.

evals.name: missing-source-material
evals.prompt: Rebuild my agent skill in Notion, but I have not provided the current skill files or a link to them.
evals.expected_output: The skill requests access to the complete source before auditing and does not invent the current contract or create a speculative page tree.

evals.name: conditional-resources-and-new-sources
evals.prompt: Migrate this skill after approval. It includes an HTML artifact, a local preview script, two near-duplicate samples, a substantial rubric, and three new articles I want to use as references.
evals.expected_output: The skill classifies each article before using it, keeps local utilities out of Notion unless they serve a clear consumer, surfaces duplicate samples, separates the rubric from runtime instructions, preserves asset-like files appropriately, and validates explicit routing after migration.
